name: FactSet
description: FactSet sells financial data and analytics on subscription to investment professionals: asset managers, investment bankers, wealth advisers and hedge funds pay yearly fees for workstations, data feeds and APIs that combine its own and third-party data (company financials, estimates, ownership, news). Almost all revenue is recurring; annual subscription value was $2.49 billion at May 2026 (organic growth 7.1 percent) and client retention was above 95 percent by value in FY2025. It reports three geographic segments and describes its clients by type (institutional buy-side, dealmakers, wealth, partnerships). It competes mainly with Bloomberg, S&P Global Market Intelligence and LSEG.

employees.note: 12,800 employees in 35 offices in 19 countries (up 3.2 percent from a year earlier); 69 percent outside the Americas.

businessLines.name: Americas
businessLines.how: Annual or multi-year subscriptions to data, analytics workstations, data feeds and APIs, billed per user or per data package and renewed each year (ASV retention above 95 percent); revenue is recurring and grows by adding users, data sets and acquired workflow products.
